derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and a presumed derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις);
def: equivalent to G1684 (ἐμβαίνω); to intrude on (figuratively)

occurrences.text: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
